message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. Fact: Li driving crane (吊车) helping Liu to uproot a tree, swinging the tree, root breaks, tree falls and hits Liu, causing death. This is accidental death due to negligence? The operator caused death by reckless operation of machinery. Likely "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide). In examples, first case: over a similar scenario (铲车装土, back up, hit cyclist, death) answer: "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". That case had also "破坏生产经营" maybe because operating equipment? But here just death. Could also be "破坏生产经营"? Not exactly. The act of swinging tree causing death is negligence. So answer: 过失致人死亡.
